rationale: Two commands: revocation of EO 5652 (one-time, executed on signing 1934-02-24) and an opening of the lands to ex-service-men entry for 91 days from plat filing, then to the general public. The opening is conditioned on an event not shown in any held text; under the 2026-10-28 ruling an end needs evidence of performance or a revoking act, and disclosing the gap does not fill it.
